invalidated_receipt.finding: The R6 receipt accurately records the substitute mutation matrix but cannot support a seal because a protected manifest-bound oracle suite does not compile.

trigger.evidence: The callback declares name := entry.Name(), but the subsequent checks use path and never read name.

why_r6_gate_did_not_detect_it.finding: The R6 driver compiled the isolated R6 reference and permanent variants plus the predecessor-only file list. It did not compile every manifest-bound oracle package.
why_r6_gate_did_not_detect_it.consequence: The 60/60 substitute mutation score remains historical evidence, but pre-candidate seal integrity is false until all protected suites compile.

candidate_scope.package_compile_result: aborted with protected oracle build error before any test execution

must_repeat: compilation of every protected oracle package

required_recovery_procedure: The oracle-author, not the verifier or implementer, corrects the unused declaration without reading or adapting to candidate behavior.
The oracle-author reruns gofmt and compiles every manifest-bound oracle package, including ./03_infra/runstore.
The coordinator records new immutable oracle and manifest hashes while preserving R1-R6 and this invalidation artifact.
The independent verifier rechecks strict JSON, hashes, package compilation, predecessor evidence, positive controls, all mutation witnesses and the full stability matrix.
A new receipt and replacement seal must reference this invalidation and may be emitted only if the corrected frozen oracle is fully green with score 1.0.
temporal_limitation: The oracle contradiction was discovered during the first candidate compilation attempt. Any correction and replacement seal occur after candidate existence and therefore cannot claim strong pre-candidate temporal isolation; the candidate must remain frozen and out of scope throughout oracle correction and revalidation.
